descriptionChirho: The proper name of the righteous patriarch from the land of Uz, central figure of the Book of Job, known for enduring suffering and divine testing. All 58 occurrences refer to a single individual across various grammatical contexts — nominative (eng: Job, spa: Job/Iyov, arb: أَيُّوبُ, hin: अय्यूब, kor: 욥, swa: Ayubu), with preposition beth 'against Job' (arb: بِ–أَيّوبَ, kor: 욥–을–향해), and with preposition kaph 'like Job' (arb: كَ–أَيّوبَ, swa: kama–Ayubu). These are purely syntactic inflectional variants of a single proper noun referent.
